mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, standard_id, spec_id, unitNet
mapper.select: SELECT id did,standard_id,unit_net FROM wms_section_steel_spec_standard_detail WHERE spec_id = #{id}

SELECT sss.specification, sssd.unit_net FROM wms_section_steel_spec sss LEFT JOIN wms_section_steel_spec_standard_detail sssd ON sssd.spec_id = sss.id and sssd.bool_delete_enum = false
WHERE sss.bool_delete_enum = false and sss.section_steel_id = #{sectionSteelId} and sssd.standard_id = #{standardId}

SELECT ssssd.standard_id id, ssssd.unit_net unitNet, s.name standard_name FROM wms_section_steel_spec_standard_detail ssssd LEFT JOIN wms_standard s ON s.id = ssssd.standard_id AND s.bool_delete_enum = false WHERE ssssd.bool_delete_enum = false AND ssssd.spec_id = #{specId}
